charts.title: single-cell-in-a-field-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 20-tick flagship run, three synced panels sharing the same footprint outline and center-of-mass marker: (left) the glucose field as a heatmap with the CPM cell's footprint outlined in white and its center of mass marked, the field's left-low-to-right-high gradient visible as the underlying color ramp; (middle) glucose depletion (Δ from t=0) on a diverging blue/red scale centered at zero — blue where the cell has net-consumed glucose relative to the initial condition (the niche-construction halo forming around the cell's footprint), red where diffusion has net-resupplied a cell; (right) the acetate field as a heatmap, starting at zero everywhere and showing the secreted plume spreading outward from the cell's footprint as the run progresses. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_flagship_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same 20-tick, cadence-1 run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: single-cell-in-a-field-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly time-series panel of the same 20-tick run, synced to the GIF's time axis: local_nutrient, biomass, and acetate_secreted on the primary (left) axis, CPM volume on a secondary (right) axis because it lives on a much larger numeric scale. local_nutrient rises briefly (diffusion outpacing early uptake) before falling to its lowest point at t=20 as the cell's own consumption takes over; biomass and volume both climb roughly monotonically; acetate_secreted rises from zero as the O2-capped dFBA overflow mechanism kicks in. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.
